questions.q: Never ______ such a large order from a single client.
questions.exp: Never 放句首要倒裝：助動詞 have 搬到主詞 we 前面，後面接過去分詞 received。we have received 沒倒裝；we have never received 跟句首的 Never 重複否定；have 後面要過去分詞。

questions.q: ______ you require further assistance, please contact the front desk.
questions.exp: 省略 if 的倒裝：Should you require…＝If you require…，後面是原形 require、主要子句是祈使句。Would 開頭會變成問句；Were 後面要接 to 不定詞；Had 後面要過去分詞。

questions.q: Had the shipment ______ on time, we would have met the deadline.
questions.exp: Had＋主詞＋過去分詞＝If the shipment had arrived，跟過去事實相反，配主要子句 would have met。

questions.q: Our team didn't receive the memo, and neither ______ the sales department.
questions.exp: 前一句是過去簡單式的否定 didn't receive，附和「也沒有」用 neither＋did＋主詞。was、has 對不上前一句的助動詞；neither 已經是否定，不再加 didn't。

questions.q: Only after the contract is signed ______ the project.
questions.exp: Only after 帶的子句（the contract is signed）照一般語序，倒裝的是後面的主要子句：can we start。can 後面接原形，不接 started。

questions.q: When ______ about the budget cuts, the director gave a clear answer.
questions.exp: 董事是「被問」的，原句 When he was asked…，主詞相同，省略主詞和 was 留下過去分詞 asked。asking 是主動；was asked 前面少了主詞，不能只拿掉主詞留下有時態的動詞。

questions.q: The renovation took much longer ______ expected.
questions.exp: longer 是比較級，配 than：than expected（比預期的久）。then 是「然後」；as 要配 as…as；that 不接在比較級後面。

questions.q: ______ the delay, the conference started on time.
questions.exp: 空格後面是名詞 the delay，用介系詞 Despite。Although、Because、Unless 是連接詞，後面要接子句。這是「先看空格後面接子句還是名詞」的那一型。

questions.q: The supplier ______ products we ordered last month has gone out of business.
questions.exp: 空格後面接名詞 products，是「供應商的產品」，用 whose。who、which 後面不直接接名詞再接另一個主詞；what 前面不能有先行詞。

questions.q: Unless otherwise ______, all meetings will be held in Room B.
questions.exp: unless otherwise noted＝unless it is otherwise noted（除非另有說明），是「被說明」，省略主詞和 be 後留過去分詞 noted。noting 是主動；note、notes 是有時態的動詞卻少了主詞。
